verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented mode where Fin drafts replies for a human to approve before they reach the customer. The closest items are adjacent controls: pre-launch testing and preview, controlled rollouts, escalation rules, and hand-off to human agents. None of these is a draft-for-approval workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I can launch in a supervised mode where the agent drafts replies for human approval before anything reaches a customer
